name.ja: EXPO2025 ENTRY GRADE 1/144 RX-78F00/E ガンダム用オプションパーツセット (EX-001 グラスフェザー装備)
name.en: EXPO2025 ENTRY GRADE 1/144 RX-78F00/E Optional parts set for Gundam (EX-001 equipped with glass feather)

description.ja: （2024/12/13記載）商品名を変更させていただきました。
description.en: (Posted on 12/13/2024) The product name has been changed.

description.ja: 大阪・関西万博「GUNDAM NEXT FUTURE PAVILION」にて上映の完全新規映像に登場する「グラスフェザー装備」をENTRY GRADEで再現できるオプションパーツセットが登場！
description.en: Introducing an optional parts set that allows you to reproduce the "glass feather equipment " that appears in the completely new video shown at the Osaka/Kansai Expo " GUNDAM NEXT FUTURE PAVILION" with ENTRY GRADE!

description.ja: • 別売りの「EXPO2025 ENTRY GRADE 1/144 RX-78F00/E ガンダム」に取り付けることで、「GUNDAM NEXT FUTURE PAVILION」の映像に登場するグラスフェザー装備の状態を再現可能。
description.en: • By attaching it to the separately sold "EXPO2025 ENTRY GRADE 1/144 RX-78F00/E Gundam ", you can reproduce the state of the glass feather equipment that appears in the " GUNDAM NEXT FUTURE PAVILION" video.

description.ja: • ソーラーパネル部分はシールで再現。
description.en: • The solar panel part is reproduced with Seal.

description.ja: • ソーラーパネル部分を折りたたむことも可能。
description.en: • The solar panel part can also be folded.

description.ja: • 新規装備の「ビーム溶接ガン」は展開状態と収納状態がそれぞれ付属。
description.en: • The newly equipped "beam welding gun" comes with both expanded and stored states.

description.ja: • 立像版を再現するランドセルパーツも付属。
description.en: • School bag parts to reproduce the statue version are also included.

accessories.ja: グラスフェザー装備×1式
